name: Meraki MCP
description: Provides dynamic access to 400+ Meraki Dashboard API endpoints with intelligent discovery, plus advanced compliance auditing (PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC2, ISO 27001, NIST), backup/restore operations, and network security analysis. Enables natural language queries to manage Meraki networks without pre-defined tools.
